name: Preventive Diplomacy Academy (PDA) 2026
description: The United Nations Regional Centre for Preventive Diplomacy for Central Asia (UNRCCA) is accepting applications for the 2026 Preventive Diplomacy Academy (PDA), a fully online program designed to bring together young leaders from Central Asia and Afghanistan to engage with diplomacy, peacebuilding, and conflict prevention through the Youth, Peace, and Security (YPS) agenda; the academy is open to women and men aged 18–29 from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, and Afghanistan who are currently studying political science, international relations, international economic relations, law, or sociology, with applications from persons with disabilities strongly encouraged, and applicants must complete an online application and submit a 60–90 second video titled “Why I am suitable to participate in the Preventive Diplomacy Academy,” with selection based on academic or professional background, community or volunteering experience, creativity, and English proficiency. |  Deadline: 28 February 2026
